partA.basis: 63 chains x 3 extra arm A samples, then 3 A-vs-A comparisons each

partB.basis: the graded comparer on the same pairs: 63 chains x 3 repeats x 2 pair kinds

partE.basis: 196 distinct (item, target claim) candidates capped at 3 per paper = ~78 items; each needs 6 arm A + 3 arm B samples and 3 A-vs-B + 3 A-vs-A graded comparisons

estimate_before_starting.note: 326 raw candidate triples reduce to 196 distinct (item, target claim) pairs. Running all 196 would cost about 3100 calls, so a cap of 3 per paper is applied and stated. The full candidate count is reported either way.
